en: I grew up in this city.
I didn't grow up in Morocco.
You grew up quickly, my friend.
You didn't grow up with your siblings.
You grew up in the big house.
You didn't grow up in the capital.
The boy has grown a lot now.
The cat didn't grow much.
The girl grew up and became nice.
She didn't grow up in the village.
We grew up in the same neighborhood.
We didn't grow up in Rabat.
You (pl.) grew up together.
You didn't grow up in this country.
The boys grew up in the alley.
The trees didn't grow quickly.
I grow and learn every day.
I don't grow like my brother.
You grow and your understanding changes.

ar: علاش نتا ما كتكبرش بحال صحابك؟
en: Why don't you grow like your friends?
You are growing and becoming good.
You do not grow up in this house.
The boy grows every year.
The plant does not grow without water.
The girl is growing up in good health.
She doesn't grow until she eats.
We grow and learn a lot.
We do not grow at the same time.
You (pl.) are growing up in a good country.
You do not grow very fast.
Her children are growing up at home.
The children do not grow up here.
I will grow up and buy a house.

lat: ma ghadich nkber f had l-mdina
en: I am not going to grow up in this city.
You will grow up and understand everything.
You will not grow without food.
You will grow up and become a doctor.
You will not grow up alone here.
This cat will grow quickly.

lat: ma ghadich ykber khuya f had l-blad
ar: ما غاديش يكبر خويا فهاد البلاد
en: My brother will not grow up in this country.
She will grow up in Morocco.
She is not going to grow much.
We will grow up and change the situation.

lat: ma ghadich nkebru f nefs l-mkan
en: We will not grow up in the same place.
You will grow up in this school.

lat: ma ghadich tkebru b had t-tariqa
en: You will not grow this way.
Kids will grow up in the square.
They will not grow up without education.
